thread:
emma: Heads-up — saw a spike in evictions for us-west spot pool (f2-gpu) between 03:20-04:10 UTC. Impacting tail latency for some premium tenants. Can we review routing/fallback options?
aj: I saw that too on the eviction dashboard. looks tied to a cloud maintenance window + a couple of large batch jobs starting.
liam: One option: implement a "burstproof" reservation for top-tier tenants so they're insulated during churn, then spill to mixed-capacity and finally to a lower-quality quantized variant.
priya: We have per-tenant weights already, but not hard reservations. Need config like `min_reserved_gpus_per_tier` + enforcement in router.
natalie: Reservation will raise baseline cost. Suggest dynamic reservations: only lock capacity when eviction_prob(region) > X and release after it falls.
devops-bot: ALERT: metric spot_eviction_rate_us-west > 2.0% for 30m.
aj: rough routing pseudocode:
```
# run in router decision path
if eviction_rate(region) > 1.5:
  priority = [reserve_pool(premium), mixed_pool(auto_quant), fallback_region, degrade_to_variant(4bit)]
else:
  priority = [mixed_pool(normal), fallback_region]
```
liam: Also add a per-request value check — don't send low-value/diagnostic requests to expensive reserved capacity. we need a `tier_cost_limit` per tenant.
priya: For experiments, propose 10% traffic A/B: pin to reservation for 48h and measure p95/p99 + cost delta. If p99 improves by >= 20% with <15% cost increase, consider rollout.
natalie: I'll draft rollout steps: infra feature flag, router config schema, dashboards (tenant_e2e_latency_by_variant, reserved_utilization, eviction_prob_by_region), and a rollback plan. Estimate 2 days infra + 1 day rollout.
emma: Also want KV/prefix cache warming for fallback variant so we don't pay cold-start latency when spilling over.
liam: Kernel/quant team can pre-generate warmed caches for common prompts — we'll need a list of hot tenants/keys.
aj: small implementation details:
- add `reservation_window_secs` to avoid flapping
- ejection policy: if reserved_utilization < 30% for 10m, release reservation
- overflow smoothing to avoid thundering by slowly shifting traffic over 30s
priya: Agree. add metric `cost_per_successful_token_by_tier` so product can evaluate tradeoffs.
natalie: I'll own the runbook and monitors. tagging owners: @liam for quant/kernel, @aj for router changes, @priya for experiments.
emma: I'll open an RFC and PR tomorrow morning and include experiment matrix + expected dashboards. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
aj: +1, please include the small Spike test plan (simulate eviction events).
liam: I'll prep quant variants and warm-cache plan.
devops-bot: NOTE: next maintenance window scheduled us-west 04:00-06:00 UTC (link: https://cloud.example/maint/4532).
priya: Thanks — let's schedule the A/B next maintenance window to minimize user-visible churn.
emma: Sounds good. I'll drop the RFC link here once created.
